name: Body Doubling
title: Book a co-working session for work you keep avoiding.
benefit: Work you keep avoiding actually gets done.
subtitle: Social Accountability
rationale: Quiet social presence makes the task harder to abandon, which is why avoided work finally gets done in company.

evidence.summary: Widely used in ADHD communities and remote-work tools with consistent self-report; controlled evidence is minimal.

indications: A specific task has been rescheduled three or more times.
Focus is fine in meetings but collapses when working alone.
